# Local fix for the Elecrow CrowPanel 7.0P board definition.
#
# The stock entry sets `menu.PSRAM.enabled.build.psram_type=opi` but never sets
# `build.memory_type`, so it falls back to platform.txt's default
# `build.memory_type={build.boot}_qspi` -> "dio_qspi". That links the QUAD PSRAM
# driver against the module's OCTAL PSRAM, and boot fails with:
#     E quad_psram: PSRAM chip is not connected, or wrong PSRAM line mode
# leaving ESP.getPsramSize() == 0 on an ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N4R8 that has 8 MB.
#
# 142 other boards in boards.txt set build.memory_type; this one was missed.
# The combination we need (dio_opi) already exists in esp32s3-libs/3.3.10/.
#
# Delete this file to revert. It is lost if the esp32 core is reinstalled or
# upgraded, so re-check PSRAM after any core update.
elecrow_crowpanel_7.build.memory_type={build.boot}_{build.psram_type}
elecrow_crowpanel_7.menu.PSRAM.disabled.build.psram_type=qspi
